metadata.description: Grimoire: knowledge bases your AI assistant reads and maintains with you.

plugins.name: grimoire
plugins.description: Knowledge bases your AI assistant reads and maintains with you. A grimoire keeps knowledge as linked Markdown pages in a git repository, so the assistant opens the right page instead of searching. Set one up, add to it, check it, share it, publish it as a website, and stay up to date automatically.

plugins.name: grimoire-dev
plugins.description: Tools for working on Grimoire itself: run the framework's validators and its quality review. Using a grimoire needs only the grimoire plugin.
